title: Sequential versus fully conditional specification for tree-based synthesis of health data
abstract: arXiv:2610.35163v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Disseminating synthetic data in place of original ones is a promising way to enforce privacy while complying with open science principles, especially in the healthcare domain. To keep pace with the rate at which researchers collect such data, there is a need for fast and flexible synthesis procedures. A popular class of such procedures is based on models of conditional distributions induced by decision trees. Such models can be combined into a synthetic distribution following two main approaches: sequential specification and fully conditional specification. However, there is currently no recommendation on which specification to use to optimize the risk-utility tradeoffs. In this work, we use both specifications to synthesize medical datasets by combining tree-based models of conditional distributions. We compare the quality of the resulting synthetic data using several metrics of risk and utility. Our results indicate no general superior

translated_title: 树模型健康数据合成中的顺序规格与全条件规格比较
translated_abstract: 用合成数据代替原始数据进行传播，是在遵守开放科学原则的同时保障隐私的一种有前景的方法，尤其是在医疗健康领域。为了跟上研究人员收集此类数据的速度，需要快速且灵活的合成流程。此类流程中一个流行的方法类别是基于由决策树诱导的条件分布模型。这类模型可以通过两种主要方式组合成合成分布：顺序规格和全条件规格。然而，目前尚无关于应使用哪种规格来优化风险-效用权衡的建议。在这项工作中，我们使用这两种规格，通过组合基于树的条件分布模型来合成医疗数据集，并使用多种风险和效用指标比较了所生成合成数据的质量。我们的结果表明，没有普遍占优的选择。
tldr: 该研究比较了基于决策树的条件分布模型在合成医疗数据时采用顺序规格与全条件规格两种方式的效果，结果显示在隐私风险与数据效用权衡上没有一种规格普遍更优。
en_tdlr: This study compares sequential versus fully conditional specifications for tree-based synthesis of medical data, showing that neither approach is universally superior in the privacy-utility tradeoff.
